title: A Smile for the Visitor
author: Zephyrine Zhou
blurb: Yara Hartwell, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
